purpose: Record the first candidate organization of repeated Delta evaluations without introducing scalar metrics, units, topology, coordinates, or empirical physical interpretation.

field_candidate.definition: A provisional organization of repeated Delta evaluations over declared evaluation contexts.
field_candidate.canonical_form: MF_Δ := FieldCandidate({ Delta_i(A_i <S_i>_{r_a,i} E_i) } over declared evaluation context Ctx_Δ,i)

evaluation_context.definition: The declared context required for any field-candidate reading of Delta evaluations.

ordered_reading.field_candidate_rule: Repeated Delta evaluations may be discussed as a provisional field only when context identity and trace order are preserved across evaluations.
ordered_reading.trace_requirement: Trace(MF_Δ) must preserve evaluation order, context identity, and ordinal classification.

witnesses.field_reading: The repeated evaluation is part of a provisional field because the same declared context records a governed class change and preserves trace identity. No scalar magnitude is asserted.
The repeated evaluation remains trace-linked even when admissibility fails at a boundary. The failure is diagnostic, not a metric discontinuity.
The trace shows repeated evaluation near a boundary without a numeric field. Persistence is governed, not measured.

governance_rules: MF_Δ may be introduced only after Delta evaluation, ordinal class, transition discipline, and admissibility-boundary state are declared.
MF_Δ does not introduce scalar magnitude, equal spacing, coordinate distance, topology, unit, or physical metric.
Variation across repeated Delta evaluations may be described qualitatively as a provisional field only when the evaluation contexts are explicitly recorded.
A field-candidate reading is invalid if it collapses Delta into distance(A,E) or treats <S> as midpoint, endpoint, substrate, or metric center.
MF_Δ does not modify RT_core and does not promote projection from provisional induction to theorem.
forbidden_inferences: MF_Δ is not a metric space.
MF_Δ is not a vector field.
MF_Δ is not a scalar field.
MF_Δ is not a physical field.
MF_Δ does not imply continuity in the analytic sense.
MF_Δ does not imply numerical magnitude.
MF_Δ does not license empirical measurement claims.

non_claims: Does not introduce a metric space.
Does not introduce a metric space.
